images.prompt: Use case: creature design vote for a children's reading game. Create a NEW landscape 3:2 sheet: STRICT grid of THREE columns by TWO rows, SIX equal square cells, thin light separators. TOP ROW = Sunmane Lion three times. BOTTOM ROW = Ruby Hummingbird three times. Do not swap rows. Column 1 STORYBOOK: the natural animal only, NO glow, NO magic, NO armour or clothing. Column 2 ELEMENTAL: strong glowing magic power, NO armour or clothing. Column 3 CHAMPION: clearly wearing armour or hero gear, NO glow or magic effects. The three must look clearly different. Painterly premium children's fantasy storybook art in the exact painting language of image 1: warm ivory background, soft hand-painted textures, detailed natural fur, feathers, skin or scales, expressive friendly-but-brave eyes, rich strong colours. Image 1 shows style, layout and how the three columns differ; do NOT draw a koala or penguin. NO text, captions, letters or numbers anywhere. No scenery, no gore, no cartoon outlines, no photorealism. Anatomically readable, no extra limbs, exactly one creature per cell, the whole body inside its own cell with an empty margin. TOP ROW: Sunmane Lion (savanna).  Column 1: Sunmane Lion, golden lion with a big shaggy mane, calm and strong. Column 2: Sunmane Lion, lion with a mane like glowing sun rays. Column 3: Sunmane Lion, lion with gold and bronze armour plates and a royal blue cape. BOTTOM ROW: Ruby Hummingbird (flower garden).  Column 1: Ruby Hummingbird, tiny green and red hummingbird hovering with a long beak. Column 2: Ruby Hummingbird, hummingbird with blurred glowing ruby-red wings leaving light trails. Column 3: Ruby Hummingbird, hummingbird with gem-tipped feathers and a tiny golden helmet.
